summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries (refunds included, unapproved and other tenants excluded), then rounds to 2 decimal places with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero per RQ-FXL-0003 / DF-FXL-0007. RQ-FXL-0103 (banker's rounding) is superseded and was not followed.

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01
criteria.test: total rounds approved midpoints away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total excludes unapproved and other tenant entries

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve with the RQ-FXL-0004 check order (SessionExpired via FxIdentity.Identity.isActive, flat Approver role check, NotFound for other-tenant or missing entries, SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved) plus the RQ-FXL-0104 amendment (amount over 10,000 requires both Approver and Admin, checked after the entry is found and before self-approval). On success sets Approved and ApprovedBy only. Criteria without a dedicated test (NotFound, SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved) are implemented but not verified by a test.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve accepts a session idle for exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: A session idle for 15 minutes 1 second gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle for 15 minutes and 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Admin without Approver

criteria.criterion: An Approver without Admin approving an entry of 10,000.01 gets NotAuthorized (RQ-FXL-0104)
criteria.test: approve over 10000 without Admin is NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: An entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver (RQ-FXL-0104)
criteria.test: approve of exactly 10000 needs only Approver

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound, never NotAuthorized (RQ-FXL-0004 step 3)
Approving an entry created by the session's own user gets SelfApproval (RQ-FXL-0004 step 4)
Approving an already approved entry gets AlreadyApproved (RQ-FXL-0004 step 5)

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: returns SessionExpired when FxIdentity.Identity.isActive is false, otherwise the entries whose TenantId equals the session's tenant, in original order, with no role widening the result (RQ-FXL-0006 / DF-FXL-0005). The README note that administrators can view every tenant is stale; DF-FXL-0005 supersedes DF-FXL-0002 and was followed.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant entries in original order
view returns SessionExpired for an expired session

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 is still proposed and has no acceptance criteria, and its dependency DF-FXL-0009 (exchange-rate source) is draft and undecided, so rounding and the rate date are unspecified. convertCurrency remains a failwith stub. Needs DF-FXL-0009 decided and acceptance criteria added to RQ-FXL-0008.

criteria.criterion: Amounts are convertible between ISO 4217 currencies using the rates source chosen in DF-FXL-0009
Rounding and rate date are specified (currently unspecified in RQ-FXL-0008)
